context.title: Choose a shipping quote
context.instructions: Return the id of the first quote with the lowest valid priceCents in the requested currency, or null. A valid quote is a non-null object with a nonempty string id, available exactly true, currency exactly equal to the requested string, and a nonnegative safe integer priceCents. Ignore other rows. Preserve both input arguments and the order of the quotes. On price ties keep the earlier input. The first argument is an array; the second argument is a currency string.

files.content: exports.shippingQuote = (quotes, currency) => { let best = null; for (const q of quotes) { if (q && typeof q.id === 'string' && q.id !== '' && q.available === true && q.currency === currency && Number.isInteger(q.priceCents) && q.priceCents >= 0) { if (!best || q.priceCents < best.priceCents) { best = q; } } } return best ? best.id : null; };
